messages:
Priya (Acme): Hey team — since last night's canary -> prod push we're seeing a lot more 'invented' facts in generation. Not subtle, the model is confidently asserting wrong company names and dates in the middle of workflows. This started after ~23:40 UTC.
Jordan (CSM): thanks for flagging @Priya. Can you paste one or two example prompts + responses? even a redacted convo helps.
Priya (Acme): yes — redacted prompt below. Prior model (v2.1) answered correctly. After the rollout (v2.3-candidate) it fabricates a patent number and a partner name.
Priya (Acme): ```
User: "Summarize Acme's integration options with partner X for legal team."
Response (v2.1): "Acme integrates via OAuth 2.0 and SSO, referencing contract ID 2019-ACME-INT-17."
Response (v2.3): "Acme integrates via a proprietary bridge with partner Z, referencing patent US-934-748."
```
Meera (Support): yikes. Do you see any change in temperature/top_p in your requests? or any new system prompt?
Priya (Acme): We didn't change client-side config; we set temp=0.0 for these API calls. No system prompt changes on our end.
Jordan (CSM): Priya — sharing this with Eng. @Ryan can you take a look? tagging Olivia from Product since rollout id is the one we deployed yesterday (deploy-bot reported 2026-04-22T23:30:12Z).
deply-bot: deploy 2026-04-22T23:30:12Z v2.3-candidate -> production (canary 10%) :white_check_mark:
Ryan (Eng Runtime): digging in — initial hypotheses: 1) model variant swapped to a different checkpoint, 2) prompt-prepend/system prompt changed during compilation, 3) quantization/kernel selection causing decoding oddities, 4) eval thresholds for canary were metric-only and missed factuality regressions.
Meera (Support): Can you run repro locally with the exact request object Priya used? Also please confirm that logs include model_version, model_commit, tokenizer hash.
Ryan (Eng Runtime): yes — ask @Priya to send a single full request JSON with headers (redact keys) and conversation id + response id. We'll replay against v2.1 and v2.3.
Priya (Acme): sharing convo id DM — request object is sent.
Ryan (Eng Runtime): confirmed receipt. Replaying now. Initial replay: v2.1 -> correct answer; v2.3 -> hallucinates same patent. Running deterministic sampling (seed) with top_k/top_p clipped.
Olivia (Product): note: canary was promoted after latency/cost/throughput looked good. We didn't have a factuality eval suite on the canary run — that's an omission.
Ryan (Eng Runtime): repro looks consistent. Hypothesis narrowed: a new tokenizer tweak in the compilation pipeline changed token boundaries for certain entity sequences, causing the model to favor spurious completions. Also checking whether the system prompt used for v2.3-candidate includes an extra instruction that biases toward inventing missing facts.
Meera (Support): For mitigation: 1) pin Acme to v2.1 via routing (we can set routing rule to match customer id) 2) roll back the v2.3->prod rollout for matching model family 3) short-term: set a strict fallback: if confidence low or entity mismatch with knowledge base then prefer no-claim response.
Jordan (CSM): Priya — would pin/rollback be acceptable while we investigate?
Priya (Acme): Yes please pin to v2.1 for now. We need this for a legal review tomorrow morning.
Ryan (Eng Runtime): I'll open a rollback to route Acme traffic to stable 2.1 and block canary for account. Also capturing eval artifacts: prompt/response diffs, tokenization traces, logits for contentious tokens.
Ryan (Eng Runtime): early root-cause update: tokenizer table change in the optimizer caused multi-token entity sequences to merge differently; combined with a small change in beam/penalty heuristics, the model sometimes prefers an invented token sequence when uncertain.
Olivia (Product): action items: add a factuality regression test to canary gate (prompt set from top customers + synthetic edge cases), add tokenization checks to model-compatibility tests, add explicit sanity-checks for new system prompts.
Meera (Support): Priya, we rolled your traffic back (routing rule created). Confirming your API requests now hit v2.1.
Priya (Acme): Confirmed — responses match prior behavior. Thank you.
Ryan (Eng Runtime): Next steps I'll attach a repro package to the internal ticket with: request JSON, prompt set, tokenization diffs, logits, and a recommended patch (revert tokenizer change + tighten beam penalties). Target ETA for patch: 48h.
Jordan (CSM): I'll follow up with Priya after patch and coordinate communication. Priya — any preference on customer-facing wording?
Priya (Acme): short note: 'We observed production regressions after a recent model rollout; we've pinned your traffic and are patching. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA.' that's perfect.
Olivia (Product): we'll also schedule a retro to improve canary gating.
Meera (Support): marking this as P1 until patch is deployed. Adding incident playbook references and tagging eng-sre. :triage:
